# [BUG] frontend-ci.yml's web-nextjs/mobile-react-native jobs fail outright (target descoped, deleted directories)

## Bug
`.github/workflows/frontend-ci.yml`'s `web-nextjs` and `mobile-react-native` jobs set `working-directory: frontend/web-nextjs` / `frontend/mobile-react-native`. Those directories were intentionally deleted in `0e3f49e` ("remove descoped dirs") once the project pivoted to using the real Filmpire React app at `frontend/filmpire` (ADR-013). The jobs' own `package-lock.json` existence check (meant to skip cleanly if "not implemented yet") never even runs — GitHub Actions fails immediately trying to `cd` into a directory that doesn't exist, before any step executes. Confirmed live: [run 30837205650](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/actions/runs/30837205650) — both jobs fail with `##[error]An error occurred trying to start process '/usr/bin/bash' with working directory '.../frontend/web-nextjs'. No such file or directory`.

This had been silently broken for a while — frontend-ci.yml only triggers on `frontend/**` path changes, and nothing under `frontend/**` had been touched in a long stretch until #101's work did, which is what surfaced it.

## Root Cause
Workflow never updated after `0e3f49e` removed the two placeholder directories it targets.

## Severity vs. Priority
**Severity (technical impact):** Minor — cosmetic CI red X, the real frontend job (`filmpire`, added by #101) passes independently and isn't blocked by this.
**Priority (business urgency):** P2 — makes the Frontend CI check permanently red, which is misleading for anyone checking build health at a glance.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Removed the two dead jobs from frontend-ci.yml — descoped work with no real target, not something to keep as a stub
- [x] Frontend CI now only runs the real `filmpire` job

## Notes
Found and fixed 2026-08-03 while verifying #101's new frontend CI job actually went green in real CI.
